notes: Every line of story text in one place (assessment-2026-10-17-rd.md step 1). Loaded by Missions/Narrative.swift; the Swift tables stay as the fallback when a key is missing. {hits} {section} {wins} {losses} are filled at runtime. Lists are rotated by the game ([wins % n], no repeats) as the Swift code did. Step 2 (18 Oct 2026) adds guidance (rule cards and cues, {n} filled), notebook (per chapter: need, lines with auto rules and three hints), goals (nine per world) and barks (event tuning; step 1 events take their lines from board / riders).

nouns.disc: A rider's route, sealed: name, memory, the right to ride. The thing you carry and the thing you duel with.
nouns.ioLine: The one route no program may ride: the line out of the system, past the spire in the core.
nouns.rule: The rule was: every program rides a route. VESS and SABLE rewrote it: every route is owned.

0.brief: New rider. Your route is provisional and I hold the licence. A disc for the downtown relay: a rider's route, sealed. Impacts and boost burn the hull, what is left pays. Ride clean and the route becomes yours.
0.debrief: VESS: Clean enough. Twenty more like that and the route is yours. Do not ask whose disc that was.

1.brief: Someone seeded the grid with beacons. Fly through them; some sit high. Five of seven and the map is ours.
1.debrief: VESS: The beacons were Kade's. Now Kade knows your trail colour.

2.brief: Relay sits past the split. Tunnel or skyway, your call. Heavier traffic this time.
2.debrief: VESS: Delivered. A rider named Kade asked about you at the relay. I said nothing.

3.brief: You picked up a tail. It is faster than your cruise. Boost opens the gap and burns hull. Reach the relay with it still behind you.
3.debrief: VESS: That was Kade's drone. It will not be a drone next time.

4.brief: The relay is below the city. Conduit sections: fly the tube, thread the beams. The hull does not like walls.
4.debrief: VESS: Kade has booked the Grid. It wants the disc. Settle it there or lose the route.

5.brief: Kade wants the disc and will not ask twice. Settle it on the Grid. Light cycles, first to two derezzes. Kade hunts: expect a wheel on your tail.
5.debrief: KADE: You ride clean. Vess does not. That disc you took down the conduit? Come out to the canyon and I will show you whose it was.

6.brief: Carry it out of the city. Canyon road, long bends, a rock-cut tunnel, a split. Daylight. Nobody is watching out there.
6.debrief: KADE: The relay out here is mine. Every disc Vess sends passes through it. Open one.

7.brief: Beacons in the canyon, high and low. Six of eight. The bends hide them until late.
7.debrief: KADE: Orin planted those. Orin runs the canyon relays for someone in the core.

8.brief: A convoy went down on the canyon road. Its drones and crates are still live. Destroy eight before the drop and the cargo is ours.
8.debrief: KADE: Discs in every crate. A rider's route is its right to ride; Sable buys them and derezzes the rider. One of them is old and gold, sold twice. Vess is not delivering these. Vess is selling them.

9.brief: Orin is behind you and it is not a drone. Keep the gap through the tunnel. The skyway is faster than it looks.
9.debrief: KADE: Orin does not lose tails. Orin will want the Grid. Fly the pipe first; you will need the precision.

10.brief: The old pipe under the mesa. No weapons, a hull that bruises twice as hard, and a window that does not forgive. Thread it.
10.debrief: KADE: Clean. Now Orin. Orin boxes: it will cut across your line and close the door.

11.brief: Orin runs the canyon relays and wants them back. Kade owes you one: the Grid is booked. Orin boxes: it will cut across your line and close the door.
11.debrief: ORIN: Fine. You win. But you are working for the wrong dispatcher. Vess sells to Sable, and the last disc you carried downtown had your route in it. Come to the core and I will prove it.

12.brief: Vess knows you have seen the crates. Your route is on Sable's list now and the drones are on you from the first metre. Boost early, thread the fields, reach the core relay.
12.debrief: ORIN: Still alive. Sable's crates move through the core at night. Let us take them apart.

13.brief: Sable's shipment runs the core grid tonight: crates and escort drones in every field. Twelve targets before the drop.
13.debrief: ORIN: That was a month of Sable's income. Sable will come to the Grid now. First we take the deep line.

14.brief: The core's data conduit: three pipes back to back, no weapons, twice the bruise. The fastest riders in the system set their times here.
14.debrief: ORIN: A core time. Vess has hidden its ledger in beacons across the core. Sweep them and we have proof.

15.brief: Vess's ledger, split across ten beacons in the densest grid in the system. Eight of ten. Some sit high over the fields. The last one is your own line.
15.debrief: ORIN: It is all there. Every route, every buyer. Yours is the last line. Sable has booked the Grid and named you.

16.brief: Sable does not box and does not hunt. Sable runs: open ground, the pads, the deck, and it will out-speed you if you let it. First to three. It rides the gold route it bought first.
16.debrief: SABLE: Derezzed by a courier I already paid for. Vess sold me a route it could not deliver. Vess is on the Grid. Go and collect.

17.brief: Vess rides its own cycle tonight, and it rides like Kade taught it: on your tail, grinding your line. First to three. Win and you ride the I/O Line out: the one route nobody owns.
17.debrief: ORIN: The licence is void. The rule is back: every program rides a route. Yours runs from downtown to the canyon to the I/O Line. Nobody dispatches you again.

0.line: Vess sends you over the skyway because Vess is watched there. Ride the split through the tunnel instead and I pay the difference. Nobody counts the tunnel.
0.debrief: KADE: The tunnel. Good instinct. Vess will not know that run happened, and I will.

1.line: You keep gaps. Now keep a window: the rock pipe again with ten seconds less. Kade pays in favours. I pay in credits.
1.debrief: ORIN: A core time out of a canyon pipe. Kade did not tell me you were that fast.

2.line: You are wrecking my shipments, so let us do business. Sweep Vess's ledger again, all ten beacons this time, and I pay more than Orin does.
2.debrief: SABLE: Paid. Now I know what Vess knows. Do not mistake this for friendship.

1.intro: The downtown grid at night. Every program on it rides a route: its name, its right to ride. Yours is provisional. VESS dispatches, holds the licence, and pays. Ride clean and the route becomes yours.
1.static: -- carrier. the disc you hold is not cargo. --
interlude: GRIPTAP & CO: Still at the cabinet. The screen went white and the kid did not come back. Same as last time.
GRIPTAP & CO: I can see the score. Somebody in there is riding.
GRIPTAP & CO: The Astro's gone off the shelf too. No wheels. Figures.

2.intro: Daylight. The canyon road out past the last relay. KADE rides out here and owes you one. ORIN runs the canyon relays for someone in the core. Nobody dispatches you here; nobody watches either.
2.static: -- carrier. it has your name in it. they do not know you can read. --
interlude: GRIPTAP & CO: The screen's gone orange. Desert, looks like. The kid's still riding.
GRIPTAP & CO: There's a gold board on the high-score line. I know that board.
GRIPTAP & CO: Whoever's in there with the kid, they're not friends.

3.intro: The core: the densest grid in the system, where the discs end up. The rule was: every program rides a route. VESS and SABLE rewrote it: every route is owned. SABLE buys routes and derezzes the riders who held them. VESS has been selling. ORIN rides with you. Yours is the last line in the ledger, and past the spire is the I/O Line, the one route out.
3.static: -- carrier. a route remembers who rode it. the line out is past the spire. finish this. --
interlude: GRIPTAP & CO: Rain on the screen now. Can't see the kid for the storm.
GRIPTAP & CO: The gold board's name just dropped a line. First time in years.
GRIPTAP & CO: One more game. I'm not closing the shop till it's over.

end.static: -- route-holder. the I/O Line is open. nobody dispatches you now. this line closes. --
end.ending: KADE: Heard the licence is void. The canyon relay is yours whenever you want it. Ride it however you like.
interlude: GRIPTAP & CO: The screen just went white again. Then the attract mode.
GRIPTAP & CO: New name on the high-score line. The gold board's second.
GRIPTAP & CO: Kid's back at the counter. Doesn't remember a thing. Wants to play again.

KADE.launch: Ride it like you stole it.

ORIN.lastStretch: Last stretch. Do not bore me.

Twice down. Out here that is once too many.

Burned a core. The canyon does that.

Hull nearly gone. Ride the middle of the road.

Not a mark on it and early. Good.

That was a gold run. Vess never paid me for one of those.

A better run. The road is learning you.

Two respawns. Sable would have laughed.

You crawled in. Boost is not a plan.

Untouched and ahead. That is core pace.

A gold. Sable will hate that.

You hit {hits}. Read the lanes earlier.

duelSweep: A sweep. Not one derez. The Grid will remember that.
Clean sweep. They never got a wall in front of you.
duelBoxed: You won, but you boxed yourself once. Watch your own trail.
Won. Your own wall nearly cost it.
duelClose: Close. {wins} to {losses}. The next one will be closer.
{wins} - {losses}. You took the hit and came back. Good.

VESS.skyway: The skyway. Half the city saw that.

KADE.tunnel: You took the tunnel. Good instinct.
KADE.skyway: The skyway. Orin watches the skyway.

*.skyway: The skyway. Not what I paid for.

VESS.CAUGHT: Caught. The disc is gone. So is the fee.
VESS.HULL: Hull breached. The disc is scrap. Try again.
VESS.TIME: Late. The relay closed. Ride the window next time.
VESS.DEREZZED: Derezzed. Kade keeps the route for now. Again.
VESS.*: Incomplete. The route does not pay for almost.

KADE.CAUGHT: They got you. Boost in the open, not in the bends.
KADE.HULL: Hull gone. The canyon wins one. Go again.
KADE.TIME: Out of time. Cut the corners, not the bike.
KADE.DEREZZED: Derezzed. Watch the walls, then watch mine.

ORIN.CAUGHT: Caught. Vess's drones do not miss twice.
ORIN.HULL: Breached. The core eats the careless.
ORIN.TIME: Late. In the core, late is dead.
ORIN.DEREZZED: Derezzed. Sable will have watched that. Again.

*.TOOK: That was the skyway. The deal was the tunnel. Again.

KADE.first: "Hunter, they call me. Do not look back."
KADE.leads: "Still riding? I left you in pieces last time."
KADE.trails: "You got lucky. The Grid does not do luck twice."
KADE.thirdLeads: "Third time. You keep coming back to lose."
KADE.thirdTrails: "Third time, courier. I have been counting."

ORIN.first: "I close doors. You will find that out."
ORIN.trails: "You cut a good line. Cut it again if you can."
ORIN.thirdLeads: "Again. The door will be where it always is."
ORIN.thirdTrails: "You have read my line. Let us see if you can read a new one."

SABLE.first: "A courier. On my Grid. This will be brief."
SABLE.thirdLeads: "You are becoming a habit. A cheap one."
SABLE.thirdTrails: "Nobody beats me {wins} times. Not for long."

VESS.first: "I taught Kade. Kade taught you. Let us see what is left."
VESS.thirdLeads: "I still hold the licence. Ride for it."
VESS.thirdTrails: "You want the route so badly? Take it from me again."

lostRoundCutOff: Told you not to look back.

KADE.rivalLeads: Feel that? That is a hunt.
KADE.matchPointAhead: One more and I will remember it.
KADE.matchPointBehind: One more. Then the disc is mine.

ORIN.lostRoundBoxed: You did my work for me.
ORIN.rivalLeads: This is what the canyon relays pay for.
ORIN.matchPointAhead: Close the door then. If you can.

SABLE.lostRoundBoxed: You are cheaper than I paid.

VESS.lostRoundBoxed: Your own trail. I taught Kade that.
VESS.playerLeads: You were a good rider. Were.
VESS.rivalLeads: The route was never going to be yours.
VESS.matchPointAhead: Take it, then. Take it from me.

launch: Routes are the currency. Run one.

derez: Saw the wall. Didn't believe it.

launch: Nothing in here taller than my airs.
derez: Up. Nobody cuts a show for one derez.

launch: Rails, conduits, anything with an edge.

derez: Cannery's going to hear about this.

lines: This card is the job: who sent it, what it pays, what counts.
Left and right browse the inbox. Y buys in the garage.
A takes the job. The road waits until you do.
briefing.title: THE JOB CARD

lines: Carry the disc to the drop before the window closes.
Every gate you pass adds time. Hits and scrapes drain the hull.
Hull left at the drop pays out.
relay.title: RELAY

lines: Fly through the red rings. Some sit high: climb for them.
A missed ring goes grey and is gone.
Reach the end with enough rings, inside the window.
sweep.title: SWEEP

lines: Something is behind you. Stay ahead of it to the relay.
Boost pulls away, but boost burns the same bar as the hull.
Caught at four metres.
run.title: RUN

lines: Shoot the marked targets before the drop.
A or L1 fires. Each target refills a little hull.
Miss too many and the job fails at the end.
salvage.title: SALVAGE

lines: A conduit time trial. No weapons.
Hits bruise the hull twice as hard.
Thread the obstacles and keep the window.
dive.title: DIVE

lines: Light cycles. Your trail is a wall, and so is theirs.
Make the rival hit a trail or a wall. Hitting your own loses the round.
Pads charge the boost. Win the rounds the card asks for.
duel.title: THE GRID

lines: An empty hull costs a respawn, not the job.
You ride on from here at half hull, four seconds down.
Two per job. The count is under the hull bar.
respawn.title: HULL RESTORED

lines: You lost a round, not the duel.
Turn early: the rival cuts across your nose.
Stay off your own trail. It kills you as well.
derez.title: DEREZZED

lines: Every world has nine goals. Once done, they stay done.
Each goal pays credits once, in jobs or in free play.
The card is on the briefing and in the pause menu.
goals.title: THE GOAL CARD

lines: Each chapter keeps a short list of things worth doing.
Lines tick themselves when you do them.
Stuck? Pause, open the notebook and call your contact.
notebook.title: THE NOTEBOOK

lines: Someone wants a job done their way. It is in the inbox, in amber.
Same road, one extra rule, a bonus on top.
The bonus pays once.
offer.title: SIDE OFFER

lines: You can afford a part. The garage is on this card.
Up and down pick a part, Y buys it. On touch, tap the row.
Parts stay fitted for every job after.
garage.title: THE GARAGE

lines.text: Tick a goal on the Neon City card.
hints: The city keeps a list. Read it.
Pause. GOAL CARD. Pick the easy one.
Shoot ten targets in one run. That is a goal.

lines.text: Carry the first disc without a scratch.
hints: The first job. Again. Better.
No hits on RELAY 01. Not one.
Replay RELAY 01 from the inbox. Hug the middle lane, shoot what blocks it.

lines.text: Silver or better on the beacon sweep.
hints: The rings remember who missed them.
SWEEP 01. Silver needs the streak.
Take every ring on SWEEP 01 without a hit between them.

lines.text: Shake the tail with a third of the window left.
hints: Being ahead is not the same as being fast.
RUN 01, FAST flag. Boost early.
Boost off the line on RUN 01 and again past halfway. Keep a third of the clock.
Someone wants THE SPLIT done their way.
Clean on RELAY 02 puts an offer in the inbox.
Clear RELAY 02 with no hits, then take SIDE 01 and stay left at the split.

lines.text: Cross the Outlands without a scratch.
hints: The canyon forgives nothing. Forgive it back.
RELAY 04, no hits.
Replay RELAY 04. Stay low under the arches, shoot what blocks the lane.
The high rings pay.
SWEEP 02, silver. Climb for the red ones.
Climb before each high ring on SWEEP 02; a hit between rings resets the streak.
Kade counts the wrecks.
SALVAGE 01, gold. Every target.
Fire early on SALVAGE 01: all eight targets, no hits, the streak does the rest.
Orin has a faster idea.
FAST on RUN 02 opens SIDE 02.
Clear RUN 02 with a third of the window left, then take SIDE 02 from the inbox.

lines.text: Four goals on the Sunset Canyon card.
hints: The canyon has its own list.
Pause. GOAL CARD in the canyon.
Free play counts: ride the canyon and do the easy four.

lines.text: Out-run the double cross with time to spare.
hints: Speed is the only alibi.
RUN 03, FAST.
Boost through the first conduit on RUN 03 and keep a third of the clock.
Sable counts too.
SALVAGE 02, silver.
Twelve crates on SALVAGE 02 with the streak unbroken by hits.

lines.text: Dive the deep line without a scratch.
hints: The pipe bruises double.
DIVE 02, no hits.
Replay DIVE 02; ride the centre of each pipe and do not boost into the bends.
Ten beacons. Sable wants ten.
GOLD on SALVAGE 02 opens SIDE 03.
Gold on SALVAGE 02, then SIDE 03: all ten rings on SWEEP 03.

lines.text: Five goals on The Grid card.
hints: The Grid keeps score of more than rounds.
Pause on the Grid. GOAL CARD.
Free play on The Grid counts. Grind a wall, take three pads, win a round.
